One cached location service graph (shared by sessions at this location)
|
|-- Shared location capabilities (not owned by the runner)
|   |-- Config / Agent / Model / Plugin / PluginHooks / Permission
|   |-- FileSystem / Shell / Snapshot / ToolOutput
|   |-- Tool registry: built-ins, plugins, MCP and code-mode
|   |   `-- snapshot(permissions) -> definitions + execute capability
|   |-- SessionContext
|   |   |-- select -> session, agent, merged permissions, tools, instructions
|   |   |   `-- Built-ins, discovery, skills, MCP, references, stored entries
|   |   |-- load -> resolved model + SessionHistory -> initial/active messages
|   |   `-- request -> shared SessionModelRequest
|   |-- SessionModelRequest
|   |   `-- primary -> plugin hooks; session transport binds options
|   `-- SessionCompaction
|       `-- estimate / compact / precompute: automatic, explicit, overflow
|
`-- SessionRunnerLLM (implements SessionRunner.Service)
    |-- Captured references -> shared capabilities, Bus, Store, SQL, Job
    |-- titles: FiberMap keyed by sessionID -> SessionTitle.generate
    |-- drain invocation: continuation/boundary state (expanded separately)
    |   |-- advanceToStep -> inbox delivery + SessionContext.select/load
    |   `-- runStep -> compaction + request.primary -> steps.attempt
    `-- steps: SessionStep.make() helper (not another service)
        |-- Captures Bus / LLMClient / Snapshot / ToolOutput references
        `-- attempt invocation: scoped publisher + tool fibers + settlement
